resources.string: Your day in the kitchen starts here
In the next version, Today shows tonight’s and tomorrow’s meals from your meal plan, recipes you cook often and a quick way back into cooking.
Your recipes are on their way
The next version brings your Tandoor recipes into the app: search, filters, books and a cooking mode with timers, also offline.
A later version shows the week’s meal plan from Tandoor, lets you add meals and puts their ingredients on the shopping list.
A later version brings Tandoor’s shopping list: sorted by store aisle, shared with your household and usable offline in the store.
This Tandoor version is too old for Tandem
Tandem has not been tested with this Tandoor version yet, so it runs in safe mode.
Your login is removed from this device. Your recipes and other data on the server are not affected, and you can log in again at any time.
Only the token Tandem created for this device is deleted on the server. Your other devices stay logged in.
You signed in with a token you pasted. Tandem leaves it on the server, because other apps or devices may use it. Delete it in Tandoor under Settings → API if you no longer need it.

Logged out on this device, but the token could not be revoked: the server could not be reached, or it (or something in front of it, such as a login portal) refused. Delete it in Tandoor under Settings → API.
Logged out on this device. The pasted token is still valid; delete it in Tandoor under Settings → API if you no longer need it.
Could not log out: secure storage on this device is not available.
The setting could not be saved.
The demo data is back to how it started.
The demo data could not be reset.
Follows the language of your phone
This changes Tandem’s own texts. Recipes, ingredients and units are shown exactly as they are in your Tandoor.
You can also change the language in Android’s settings under Apps → Tandem → Language.
An Android app for Tandoor Recipes, the recipe manager you host yourself.
Not affiliated with the Tandoor project
Tandem is an independent app made for Tandoor. Please report problems with Tandem to Tandem, not to the Tandoor project.
Tandem only talks to the Tandoor server you connect it to. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
